meta.name: performance-analyzer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "analyze influencer campaign performance", "compare influencers", or "find what content worked"; produces metric scorecards vs target and benchmark, platform/influencer/content rankings, engagement-quality and sentiment reads, conversion-attribution breakdowns, and ranked learnings. Not for dollar-level return math — use roi-calculator.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析达人营销活动效果，生成指标评分卡与排名洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估达人合作效果并优化投放策略
copy.tagline_en: Analyze influencer campaign performance with metric scorecards and rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate influencer partnerships and optimize campaign strategy

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析网红活动效果：对比目标与基准，按平台、创作者、内容排名，评估互动质量和情感倾向，归因转化，并给出优化建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析网红活动效果、比较创作者或找出哪些内容有效时触发。

say.text: 分析我们夏季护肤活动的效果。
say.note: Claude 会生成核心指标评分卡、排名和洞察。

say.text: 比较 @influencerA 和 @influencerB 的表现。
say.note: Claude 会对比两人的覆盖、互动率、转化等。

say.text: 找出这次活动中哪些内容表现最好。
say.note: Claude 会按内容排名并总结成功模式。

howto.what_en: Analyzes influencer campaign performance: scores metrics vs target/benchmark, ranks platforms/creators/content, reads engagement quality and sentiment, attributes conversions, and writes ranked learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze influencer campaign performance, compare influencers, or find what content worked.

say_en.text: Analyze performance of our summer skincare campaign.
say_en.note: Claude produces a scorecard, rankings, and insights.
Claude compares reach, ER, conversions, etc.

say_en.text: Find what content worked best in this campaign.
say_en.note: Claude ranks content and names winning patterns.
